title: Index of a polynomial-estimation sample
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and let the failure parameter lie in $(0,1/2]$. A polynomial-estimation sample with index $i$ is assigned the index $N m+i$ in the combined restricted sample space, where $N$ is the size of the low-degree junta Fourier family and $m$ is the coefficient-estimation sample count.
hypotheses_covered: Finite set $P$ of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$
$i$ is a valid polynomial-estimation sample index
